preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < N for i in range(N)) and all(0 <= H_i <= 10**9 for H_i in H) and len(H) == N
preconditions.description: N is the number of shamans (2 ≤ N ≤ 100000), and H is a list of N integers representing altitudes (0 ≤ H_i ≤ 10^9).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= v <= U for v in range(U)) and all(0 <= A_i < N and 0 <= B_i < N and A_i != B_i for (A_i, B_i) in trust_log) and len(trust_log) == U
preconditions.description: U is the number of days (0 ≤ U ≤ 200000), and trust_log is a list of U pairs (A_i, B_i) representing trust changes (start/stop) between shamans on day i-1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < N and 0 <= y < N and x != y and 0 <= v <= U for (x, y, v) in queries) and len(queries) == Q
preconditions.description: Q is the number of queries (1 ≤ Q ≤ 50000), and each query is a tuple (x, y, v) where x is the suspected Thief, y is the suspected Evil Shaman, and v is the suspected day (0 ≤ v ≤ U).
D is the maximum number of trusted friends a shaman can have at any given time (1 ≤ D ≤ 500).

postconditions.description: For each query (x, y, v), the output is the minimum distance between a trusted friend x' of x and a trusted friend y' of y on day v. If either x or y has no trusted friends, output 10^9. If x' == y', output 0. Otherwise, compute the minimum absolute altitude difference between all valid pairs (x', y').
